description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller that provides a health check endpoint for database connectivity. It attempts to retrieve a connection from the configured DataSource and returns status information including driver details and connection URL, or error details if the connection fails.

classes.name: DbHealthController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for checking database connectivity health status.

methods.name: DbHealthController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller with a DataSource instance.

methods.name: dbHealth
methods.description: Endpoint method that attempts to get a database connection and returns connectivity status and metadata.
